//: Shared Deno config for the Supabase edge functions. The `imports` map lets every function reference deps by bare specifier (createClient from "@supabase/supabase-js") instead of an inline https://esm.sh / jsr: URL — required by newer Deno's no-import-prefix / no-unversioned-import lint rules and the standard way `supabase functions deploy` resolves deps. supabase-js was pinned inline at a mix of @2 / @2.39.0 / @2.45.0 across functions (nobody pinned deliberately — all v2, same createClient/query API); standardized here to the jsr @2 line Supabase's own edge templates use. no-explicit-any is excluded from lint because `any` is a deliberate, documented pattern in this codebase.
